title: Troops Rescue Two More Abductees in Askira/Uba, Borno
detail: Troops of the 115 Task Force Battalion, conducting ongoing search-and-rescue operations in Askira/Uba LGA, Borno State, rescued two additional abductees from a terrorist hideout on July 7. The operation also recovered ₦1.2 million in cash suspected to be proceeds of criminal activity, along with food items and logistics believed to have supported terrorist operations — part of the sustained clearance push in the area following the May 15 school abduction wave.

media.caption: Nigerian troops rescue two more abductees in Askira/Uba, Borno State

title: One Killed, One Injured in Farmer-Herder Clash in Beji, Niger State
detail: A clash at Danini village in Beji, Niger State on July 7 at around 1:30pm left one person, Mustapha Ismail, dead and another injured after an altercation involving three men led by one Abubakar Sadiq while Ismail was working his farm. The incident, though smaller in scale than the July 1 Tegina violence, reflects the continued fragility of farmer-herder relations across Niger State's Rafi and surrounding LGAs.

media.caption: One killed in fresh farmer-herder clash in Beji, Niger State
